verses.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲלֹ֥ות הִנֵּ֤ה ׀ בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֹֽות׃
verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ هُوَذَا بَارِكُوا ٱلرَّبَّ يَا جَمِيعَ عَبِيدِ ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱلْوَاقِفِينَ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ بِٱللَّيَالِي.
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, that stand in the house of the LORD in the night seasons.
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all [ye] servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

verses.ar: ٱرْفَعُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ نَحْوَ ٱلْقُدْسِ، وَبَارِكُوا ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.en: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, and bless ye the LORD.
verses.kjv: Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
verses.web: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!

verses.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיֹּ֑ון עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: يُبَارِكُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنْ صِهْيَوْنَ، ٱلصَّانِعُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.en: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; even He that made heaven and earth.
verses.kjv: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.web: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
